summary: Cross-schema final review closing the 119K-through-119AB Repository Intelligence executable schema implementation line before Track B opens Phase 120. Reviewed all eight artifact-family schemas and all twelve shared components as a coherent whole. Confirmed: 20/20 schemas parse and declare JSON Schema Draft 2020-12; 20 unique $id values; 477 local $ref occurrences with zero broken references; consistent common artifact envelope, source attribution, evidence boundary, uncertainty/verification state, conflict/supersession, boundary disclosure, and disclaimer usage across all eight families; 108 object definitions, 107 declaring additionalProperties: false and one (conflict_supersession_record's preserved_history.items) intentionally left unconstrained to preserve arbitrary historical snapshot shapes; zero authority-creep language across all 20 schemas and the README; fully coherent cross-phase documentation. No schema or shared-component corrections were required. Documented, without correcting, two minor pre-existing cosmetic naming inconsistencies in contract_conformance_record (119M, predating later naming conventions). Classified three known inherited tooling/reporting issues (119Q report-generation-ordering defect, is_phase_id_backward() phase-id comparison bug, recurring Telegram notification-timing report detail) as non-blocking for 120A, explicitly deferring their repair. Concluded the complete 119 executable schema line is ready to inform Phase 120A.
